name: Furukawa Yui
source:
A mysterious transfer student who [url=/c477]Sou[/url] found naked. A gentle person who does things at her own pace, and is rather clumsy as well.

[From [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2010/12/07/%E5%A4%B1%E3%82%8F%E3%82%8C%E3%81%9F%E6%9C%AA%E6%9D%A5%E3%82%92%E6%B1%82%E3%82%81%E3%81%A6-review/]Accany's review[/url]]

[spoiler]She is the true main heroine of story. Created by [url=/c477]Sou[/url] from the future with the purpose of returning to the past to prevent [url=/c474]Kaori's[/url] accident.[/spoiler]
